Success criteria: The center of the red block's bottom face is near the center of the blue mat's top surface, and its bottom rests on the mat. The right gripper is open and the block released.

## Execution tips

- The left gripper may grasp flat lower-middle regions of opposite red-block faces, avoiding the bottom edge and vertical corners while leaving upper space for the right gripper. Open slightly wider than the grasp region and confirm the fingers straddle it before closing.
- During the handoff, offset the grippers along the height of the red block to leave room between the fingers. Release the left gripper only after the right gripper has a secure hold to avoid dropping the block.
- When placing the red block, keep its long edge vertical if possible and make small position corrections above the mat. Release after its bottom is on the mat to reduce the risk of tipping or landing on the mat’s edge.
